dr_libs upstream: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
Pinned commit: e1f125c1e03ba65e98dcbe54bab2b9b86d7ccd1a
Pinned date: 2026-07-14

The vendored single-header decoders are dr_wav.h, dr_mp3.h, and dr_flac.h.
Each header contains its upstream public-domain or MIT-0 license notice.

Embedded profile patch: dr_flac recognizes DR_FLAC_NO_SEEKTABLE. The decoder
then uses its upstream binary/brute-force seek path instead of retaining a
file-provided seek table in the fixed RAM arena.
